original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚警方调查警员死亡事件，FBI通缉诈骗犯落网等要闻回顾
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚警方对科吉州ASCO营地一名警员死亡事件展开调查，据称下士Amos Yusuf开枪打死女同事Grace Onimisi后自杀。阿布贾联邦高等法院驳回了前卡杜纳州州长Nasir El-Rufai就涉嫌非法截取国家安全顾问电话通讯提出的无案可辩申请。FBI表示已在四大洲抓获六名头号通缉诈骗犯，并查获约170亿美元。

location.raw_text: Ajaokuta ASCO Camp in Kogi State

key_facts.fact: 警方对科吉州ASCO营地一名警员死亡事件立案调查
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The death of a police corporal, Amos Yusuf, who allegedly shot dead his female colleague, Woman Corporal Grace Onimisi, before shooting himself at the Ajaokuta ASCO Camp in Kogi State, has been flagged for investigation by police authorities.

key_facts.fact: 据称该警员开枪打死女同事后自杀
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: who allegedly shot dead his female colleague, Woman Corporal Grace Onimisi, before shooting himself

key_facts.fact: 阿布贾联邦高等法院驳回El-Rufai的无案可辩申请
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A no-case submission filed by former Kaduna State Governor, Nasir El-Rufai ... has been dismissed by a Federal High Court in Abuja.

key_facts.fact: FBI称在四大洲抓获六名头号通缉诈骗犯并查获约170亿美元
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: six of its most-wanted fraudsters have been captured across four continents, while its global crackdown on scam networks has resulted in the seizure of about $17bn.
